title: Stanley McDaniel's book on NASA's failure to investigate Mars structures

tellings.quote: Stanley McDaniel a professor ameritus at Sonoma State University wrote a 200-page book about NASA's failure to properly investigate the structures on Mars

plain: In the 1990s, a professor emeritus at Sonoma State University named Stanley McDaniel wrote a 200-page book arguing that NASA, the US space agency, failed to properly investigate what he saw as structures on the surface of Mars. Michels brings up the book himself, on an episode with a guest named Joe McMoneagle about life on Mars. If McDaniel was right, the agency would have looked away from possible signs of something built on another planet.
